en: Dependent on a state that is both defiled and subject to defilement and is a cause, there arises a state that is neither defiled nor subject to defilement and is not a cause, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are thirteen [conditions] in the case of root; nine in the case of object; ... eight in the case of result; ...
thirteen in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is defiled, subject to defilement, and not a root-condition, there arises a state that is not defiled, subject to defilement, and not a root-condition, by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; … pe … six in the case of result; … pe … nine in the case of non-disappearance.
